maintenance_rules: Do not add wiki claims without key-point evidence.
Do not add key points without raw-data evidence.
Prefer updating existing key points over duplicating concepts.
When evidence conflicts, preserve both claims and mark the conflict.
Selection rules should cite key-point IDs rather than raw papers directly.
Generated wiki prose is not primary evidence; raw_data and key_points are the evidence chain.
Discover collections and their optional layers from this manifest; legacy_alias entries delegate claims to canonical_collection.
Source inventories classify conversions, aliases, scratch material, and discovery indexes; an index entry is not an acquired paper.
Short evidence notes explicitly state which primary-source surface was inspected; they are not full-text acquisitions.

collections.description: Product-formula and Trotter-Suzuki evolution context for OpenQEvo.
Randomized quantum evolution context, including qDRIFT and randomized product formulas.
Split-Hamiltonian interaction-picture quantum algorithm context and dense reference boundaries; QIT-style is an ambiguous legacy label.
Annealing and adiabatic quantum evolution context.
Official and source-derived software evidence, not a quantum evolution algorithm family.
Classical exponential-action references and quantum Krylov subspace algorithms, with explicit implementation boundaries.
Preserved legacy qDRIFT conversions and discovery surveys; maintained claims live in randomized_methods.
